}} '''Vaal Immortal Call''' is a [[Vaal skill|vaal]] [[spell]] that for a brief duration renders the player unable to drop below 1 life. This skill gem can no longer be obtained. Existing copies of the item are only available in [[permanent league]]s. ==Skill Functions and Interactions== Upon usage, for a short duration the player's health cannot drop below 1, thus the player is unable to die. Despite having the [[Guard skill|Guard]] gem tag, Vaal Immortal Call is not affected by modifiers to guard skill duration or guard skill cooldown recovery rate. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression | c1_abbr = increased
